welcome: Welcome, {name}. Thousands are watching. Try to die somewhere well lit.
death: {name} is dead. Viewers rated it a six.
respawn: Tutorial mercy applied to {name}. This will not last.
levelup: {name} reached level {level}. The bar was on the floor, but still.
party: {a} and {b} have joined forces. Betrayal odds are now posted in the lobby.
collapse: Time is up. The level has been recycled. Everyone pretend that did not hurt.
ability_up: {name}'s {ability} is now level {level}. Practice makes carnage.

dot: It keeps hurting long after the fun part is over. Sponsors love that.
damage: Crude, loud and effective. Much like its inventor.
Legal has asked that we call it a 'device'.
slow: Nothing says teamwork like making the other team walk funny.
It makes things slow. You will relate.
root: It holds things still so you can make worse decisions at them.
stun: A brief nap for whoever is on the receiving end.
Side effects include seeing stars and losing fights.
